meta.title: TSV Phönix Steinsfurt – Join the Team!
meta.description: Football in Steinsfurt: we're looking for footballers aged 18+ for our first and second team. Training, team spirit, community – come to a trial session!

hero.title: Your club. Your team. Your game.
hero.subtitle: Aged 18+ and keen to play football? Come along – trial sessions are possible any time.

about.title: More than just a club
about.text: For decades, TSV Phönix Steinsfurt has been home to everyone who loves football. Whether you're ambitious or just play for fun – you'll find your place here, on and off the pitch.

teams.title: Find your team
teams.groupAlt: Team photo of the first and second team of TSV Phönix Steinsfurt

items.name: First team
items.vibe: Ambitious, well-drilled – and always hungry for the next win.

items.name: Second team
items.vibe: Perfect for starting out, coming back and getting match time.

items.title: Structured training
items.text: Varied sessions with a plan – technique, tactics, fitness.

items.title: Great pitch & facilities
items.text: Well-kept grass, artificial turf for winter, floodlights and modern changing rooms.

items.title: Athletic training
items.text: Strength, speed and stamina – trained specifically so you stay fit all season.

items.title: Kit
items.text: Training and match kit in club colours – provided by the club.

items.title: Team events
items.text: End-of-season party, training camp, summer fest – we celebrate together.

items.title: Community
items.text: A club where people know each other – and look out for each other.

items.title: Season finale
items.text: At the end of the season we celebrate together – with all teams, coaches and supporters.

items.title: Locker-room party
items.text: After a win the music gets loud – the locker room is where we celebrate.

items.title: Team nights
items.text: Barbecues, bowling, karting – regular get-togethers, off the pitch too.

gallery.title: This is what TSV feels like

training.title: Just come along
training.text: No sign-up, no stress: bring your boots and some enthusiasm – we'll take care of the rest. A quick heads-up beforehand is appreciated.
training.address: TSV Phönix Steinsfurt sports ground, 74889 Sinsheim-Steinsfurt, Germany

contact.title: Fancy it? Get in touch!
contact.text: Just message us on WhatsApp or give us a call – we'll get back to you quickly.
